## History

Mary was an orphan girl who suffered under the care of Mrs. [Grimble](../character/grimble.md), who overworked, underfed, and poorly clothed her while thrashing her without pity for minor errors. After enduring this harsh treatment, she spent a solitary night frozen and famished in a hay barn. She was ultimately discovered inside [James](../character/james-a.md) Taylor's former hay barn in a state of actual starvation by the [Ashdowns](../codex/factions.md#ashdowns).

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P4](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0004), [v5 CHAPTER VIII. MISS WINIFRED INTERVENES P8](../source/v05-c08.md#nw-v05-c08-p0008), [v5 CHAPTER IX. IDA INTERVENES P43](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0043)_
